entries.scope: Initiative, listed accuracy, five actions, ordinary Pokemon damage; numeric formulas remain subject to catalog review.
Reviewed Champion sheets inherit Master skill/defense/initiative benefits; legacy unreviewed Champion sheets still require review.
Single- and multi-target actions, target-specific responses, rank caps, increasing priority chains, early/late resolution, held turns and Will/Loyalty-gated Cover an Ally. GM confirms abstract range.

Target-specific Evasion, Never Miss restriction, action budgets and area-versus-area Clash. Table overrides: Evasion once per turn, Clash per eligible incoming attack. Successful Area Clash deflects the whole area attack; Clash damage applies to the two participants.

GM authorizes narrative prerequisite once per encounter; pain relief, one failed action die reroll per roll/round, unremovable single-roll success, and scene-end fainting at zero Will. Recovery remains outside this milestone.
Type immunities, Paralysis, Sleep, Confusion, Flinch, Disable, In Love, timed expiry and switch cleanup. Severe burn/poison escalation has contradictory values and requires a recorded GM outcome.
Ordinary move attempts against 5 HP/defenses 2 ice before next round; successful super-effective move breaks ice. Snow and special damage against ice require adjudication.
Protect, Recover, Slack Off and Soft Boiled. One shield attempt/round, consecutive penalty 2/4/8; Basic Heal capped at 3 HP/round and spends Will. Other shields/heals remain manual.

Reviewed Thunder Shock, Thunderbolt, Thunder Punch, Spark, Hyper Fang and Confusion; chance dice succeed on 6, spend no extra action, respect named immunities and per-round Flinch limits. Other entries remain manual.
Sonic Boom always 1 typeless damage, bypassing defenses and shields. Other fixed and varied formulas remain manual.
Submission rerolls raw damage successes against user. Hyper Beam adds one recharge action next round after an un-cancelled hit. Other definitions remain manual.
Agility uses an encounter-only Dexterity +2, not a permanent sheet edit; comprehensive signed modifier channels and other moves require review.

Blaze, Overgrow and Swarm remove matching move pain and add 2 damage dice at half HP. Thick Fat reduces Fire/Ice damage by 1. Own Tempo and Oblivious provide named status immunities. Torrent text/icon conflict remains manual. Other ability interactions remain manual.
Repeated-move exceptions, charge timing and successive multi-hit actions need a separate reviewed state machine; strict ordinary repeat restrictions remain active.
Battlefield/allied/opposing-side targeting, GM-recorded persistent field effects, durations, expiry and removal. Mechanical weather/terrain/force-field effects and temporary typing remain manual.
Human-target and optional lethal damage need separate resource rules. Ordinary Pokemon damage does not imply these are supported.
Every field is labelled reviewed/unverified. Complete queue preserves stable IDs, source hashes, missing references and missing assets. Unverified is not a claim that data is wrong.
Host validates, rolls and atomically commits; appointed GM controls rulings. Stored state, rollback, revision checks and receipts retain existing guarantees.
